rows.text: calls `00233050` with its arguments unchanged and, when the returned word is non-negative, adds to it the low 16 bits of (word `rcx+0x40` plus 1) times the sign-extended low word of `r8d`; returns the word, unchanged when negative

switches on dword `[rdx]`: for 4 it fills a stack vector (dword `01EF93F0`, -1.0 `01CEBC9C`, dword `01EF93F8`, 0), calls `003CBFA0(02AED560, buffer)`, zeroes the buffer's dword `+0xC`, calls `00202DE0(buffer, buffer)` and stores at word `+0x58` of qword `rcx+0x38` that signed word times (1.0 minus 1.428571 times (min(1.0, max(0.3, `00202D20(vector, buffer)`)) minus 0.3)), truncated; for 2 it returns 0 at once when `0028F810()` is negative, else calls `0028F810` twice more and, when `rcx` is non-null, stores the third result at word `+0x9A`, 0 at `+0x98`, dword `01E0C1D8` at `+0x9C` and dword `01E0C1DC` minus the second result at `+0x9E`; for 1 it calls `00247570(rcx, 002735E0(0))`, then (when `rcx` is non-null) stores dword `01E0C1DC` minus the second `0028F810()` at word `+0x9A`, 0 at `+0x98`, dword `01E0C1D8` at `+0x9C` and the first `0028F810()` at `+0x9E`, and calls `00247930(rcx, 0xA1)`; those three cases return 0, and any other value returns `005C5230(rcx, rdx)`

multiplies float `022D930C` in place by dword `01EF93F0`, copies the 16-byte vectors at `rcx` and `rdx` to `022D92E0` and `022D92F0`, stores the products y1*z2, z1*x2 and x1*y2 at `022D91A0`, `022D91A4` and `022D91A8`, stores the cross product of the two xyz parts (y1*z2-z1*y2, z1*x2-x1*z2, x1*y2-y1*x2) at `022D9300`, `022D9304` and `022D9308`, and copies the 16 bytes at `022D9300` to `r8`

stores the bit pattern of `xmm1`, sign-extended to a qword, at `022D8F30`, copies the 16 bytes at `022D8F30` to `022D92F0`, subtracts `xmm1` from each of the four floats of the 16-byte vector at `rcx`, and writes the result to both `022D92E0` and `rcx`
takes `v = 003BB420(rcx)` (other arguments passed through), calls `0017D280(00D22888, v)` and tail-jumps `0026B4E0(rcx, v)`
takes `v = 003BB420(rcx)` (other arguments passed through), calls `0017D280(00D228A8, v)` and tail-jumps `0026B4E0(rcx, v)`

reads three values a, b, c with three `00267E10(r9)` calls and takes `p = 00359EA0(c, b, a)`; when `p` is non-null and `00262F50(rdx, p)` is non-zero it calls `0026B4E0(rcx, 1)`, `0017D280(00D22B30, c)`, `0035AE10(p, 1)` and `0017D280(00D22B58, 00263A30(byte p+0x15, word p))`; otherwise it calls `0026B4E0(rcx, 0)` and `0017D280(00D22B80, c)`
stores `00D81200` at qword `[rcx]`, calls `006BAED0(rcx)`, then `00809054(rcx+0x58, 0x10, 2, 0016D6A0)` and `00809054(rcx+0x38, 0x10, 2, 0016D6A0)`, and tail-jumps `006AA200(rcx)`
when qword `rcx+0x18` is non-null calls it with qword `rcx+0x20` as `rcx`; returns 0 on both paths

notes: Appended-row drafts only (page led by FABLE); no edits proposed to existing text. 0029BC80: the case values come from two 'sub ecx, 1' steps and a 'cmp ecx, 2', so the cases are 1, 2 and 4; the default path returns 005C5230's eax (it jumps past the 'xor eax, eax'); the float used in case 4 is assumed to be 00202D20's xmm0 return; the dwords 01E0C1D8 and 01E0C1DC are named by address only (their snapshot values 0x200 and 0x1C0 may change at run time). 00398390: x1..z1 are the floats at rcx, x2..z2 those at rdx; the fourth lane copied to r8 is the float at 022D930C after the multiply. 003A2B90: the upper half of the 16 bytes read from 022D8F30 (022D8F38..3F) is whatever is stored there; only lane 0 is broadcast for the subtraction. 0050C670/0050C8D0/00510870: the strings at 00D22888, 00D228A8, 00D22B30, 00D22B58 and 00D22B80 are not decoded in the pack, so their text is not stated.
